content.text: Now let me check what region code corresponds to Bretagne and what provider activity codes correspond to nurses:

input.sql: SELECT DISTINCT BEN_RES_REG, BEN_RES_REG_LIB FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_REGION WHERE BEN_RES_REG_LIB LIKE '%Bretagne%' OR BEN_RES_REG_LIB LIKE '%Brittany%'
SELECT DISTINCT PSE_ACT_SNDS, PSE_ACT_SNDS_LIB FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_PROVIDER_ACTIVITY WHERE PSE_ACT_SNDS_LIB LIKE '%nurse%' OR PSE_ACT_SNDS_LIB LIKE '%infirm%'

Perfect! Now I have all the information I need. I can see that:
- Bretagne has region code 53
- INFIRMIER (nurses) has PSE_ACT_SNDS code 24
- I need to filter for February 2025 (FLX_ANN_MOI would be 202502)
- The quantity of acts is in PRS_ACT_QTE column

input.final_sql:
SELECT SUM(PRS_ACT_QTE) as total_acts_quantity
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS
WHERE BEN_RES_REG = 53
  AND PSE_ACT_SNDS = 24
  AND FLX_ANN_MOI = 202502

final_sql:
SELECT SUM(PRS_ACT_QTE) as total_acts_quantity
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS
WHERE BEN_RES_REG = 53
  AND PSE_ACT_SNDS = 24
  AND FLX_ANN_MOI = 202502
